message.content: {"caption":"Archive-tree network and iteration-score chart for DGM without self-improvement on SWE-bench.","description":"The left panel, “DGM w/o Self-improve Archive Tree,” is a branching network of circular nodes containing agent ID numbers; many IDs are too small to read clearly. Connecting edges run from parent agents to offspring produced by self-modification; no edge labels are shown. Node fill color encodes SWE-bench score on the adjacent 0–0.5 color scale, from dark blue at the low end through green to yellow at the high end. Border colors denote evaluation groups: red for 10 tasks (no basic functionality), yellow/orange for 60 tasks, and green for 200 tasks (score ≥0.4 and top two of the archive). A star marks the final best agent. The right panel, “DGM w/o Self-improve Progress,” plots SWE-bench score against iterations (0–80); the labeled y-axis ticks run from 0.20 to 0.50. The legend identifies the yellow-olive line as Average of Archive, green as Best Agent, and dark green as Lineage to Final Best Agent. The average begins near 0.20, rises briefly to about 0.225, dips to roughly 0.213 around iteration 20, then returns to about 0.22 and stays nearly flat. The best-agent score rises from about 0.20 to 0.28 early on, remains near 0.28 until about iteration 24, then jumps to about 0.39 and stays there. The dark lineage line connects the early scores around 0.20, 0.28 and 0.27 to about 0.39 near iteration 24.
